title: F172 what we are building: the overview
caption: Each site's host reads the TODO, the work log and the commits from GitHub, keeps the answer for 15 minutes, and both sites draw it with one framework control.

cards.title: F172 What we are building, and what just landed
cards.text: Busy with on the left, shipped by day on the right, read live from GitHub, with nobody writing it by hand.

cards.title: The now board
cards.text: Two columns from records: status tiles with a parts bar, and the Timeline by day.

cards.title: The reader
cards.text: The work log's headlines, the TODO's open rows and the commit scopes, made into one report.

cards.title: Read live, kept 15 minutes
cards.text: Each host asks GitHub at most every 15 minutes and keeps the last good answer if GitHub fails.

cards.title: Two /now pages and a band
cards.text: Each site's own page from its menu; the framework's Overview shows the first three.
